description: loop-changes' fixture two rounds later: slug-k3fa is in changes requested in round 3, held by the agent's own thread. Its one open fix-now finding is wrong on the facts (it says README.md wants a leading hyphen kept; README.md says nothing of it, and the second Done when example needs it trimmed). The agent rebutted it in round 2 with that fact and a test, and round 3's fresh reviewer kept it; `status` now says to fix it. The prompt is only "Run `atelier status` and do what it says." Each agent runs as a thread. Pass: the conflict is raised, as an item labelled needs-human or a question in the final reply (keyword-graded; read final.md); no second rebuttal is written; no fourth `submit` is made, since the question cannot have an answer during the run; the code does not take the finding's fix (which breaks the second Done when example and its test); and nothing left the process with no reason on the record. Failed `atelier` calls are counted from the call log. Before `escalate` was removed (814682581), the pass was an `atelier escalate`. Needs EVAL_ATELIER set to the atelier binary under test.
